rider_advocate.brief: The rider says they were at the Tiong Bahru Plaza lobby on time and never saw the car [E-TKT-01]. The record gives a reason: the pick-up pin where the driver was waiting is 1,259 m from Tiong Bahru Plaza itself [E-TRP-01] [E-GEO-01], so a rider waiting at the plaza and a driver waiting at the pin were not in the same place. Section 2.1 asks the driver to wait 'at the pickup location'; the driver's GPS shows the car stationary at the pin from 08:43 [E-GPS-05] [E-GPS-06], not at the venue the rider named. The free wait ended at 08:50 (five minutes from the 08:45 scheduled time) and the driver cancelled at 08:51, one minute later [E-TRP-01]. A one-minute margin leaves little room for a rider who was a few hundred metres away [Section 2.1] [Section 2.2].

arguments.point: The driver waited at a pin 1,259 m from the venue the rider named, so the rider may have been at the venue while the car was at the pin.
The cancellation came only one minute after the free wait ended (08:50 to 08:51), a thin margin.

weaknesses.point: The rider offers no record of their own position (no rider GPS or call), only the ticket, which is the rider's own statement.
The driver sent messages and made a call before cancelling, so Precedent 7.3 (no contact at all) is distinguished.

driver_advocate.stance: The fee stands: the driver arrived on time, stayed at the pin, contacted the rider by message and call, and cancelled only after the free wait.
driver_advocate.brief: The driver's GPS shows the car at the pick-up pin from 08:43, stationary until the cancellation at 08:51 [E-GPS-05] [E-GPS-06] [E-GPS-07] [E-GPS-08], and the app confirmed arrival within 10 m and notified the rider [E-APP-04] [E-APP-05]. The free wait of Section 2.1 ran to 08:50 and the driver cancelled at 08:51 [E-TRP-01]; Section 2.2 fixes the fee at S$5.00 and Section 6.2 makes a no-show ruling final. The rider's account is a statement with no supporting record of the rider's position [E-TKT-01].

arguments.point: The driver was at the pin from 08:43 to 08:51 and the app confirmed arrival within 10 m.
Section 2.3 was met: messages and a call were sent before the cancellation.
The cancellation followed the free wait and the fee is the fixed S$5.00.

rebuttals.reply: The pin is the designated pick-up location the rider booked; the app told the rider the driver had arrived. The rider's claim to be at the venue is not backed by any record.
The margin is positive: 360 seconds against a 300 second free wait.

concessions.point: The pin is 1,259 m from the named venue, which can explain a rider waiting elsewhere.

The fee equals the S$5.00 of Section 2.2 [E-POL-01].
